claims.quote: Our rock-solid support to Ukraine is vital for keeping us safe here in the UK
claims.statement: UK support for Ukraine is vital for keeping the UK safe.

claims.quote: we are with you for as long as it takes
claims.statement: The UK will stand with Ukraine for as long as it takes.

claims.quote: our commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable
claims.statement: The UK's commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable.

claims.quote: I urge partners to back the ban on Russian LNG
claims.statement: Partners should back the ban on Russian LNG.

facts.quote: The UK has already committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 LMMs to Ukraine over the next four years
facts.statement: The UK has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 LMMs to Ukraine over the next four years.

facts.quote: The Prime Minister has also asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid, and fiscal packages
facts.statement: The Prime Minister has asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid and fiscal packages.

facts.quote: This comes after the Foreign Secretary did the same with partners at the Warsaw Security Forum yesterday [TUE].
facts.statement: The Foreign Secretary urged partners at the Warsaw Security Forum to implement an equivalent ban on Russian LNG.

facts.quote: standing by plans to fully implement a maritime services ban on Russian liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports
facts.statement: The UK is standing by plans to fully implement a maritime services ban on Russian LNG exports.

facts.quote: including delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles deliveries
facts.statement: The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine.

facts.quote: As Russia continues its bombardment of Ukraine’s capital Kyiv and energy infrastructure
facts.statement: Russia continues its bombardment of Kyiv and Ukraine's energy infrastructure.

mentions.name: Andy Burnham
mentions.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
